meta.title: Guillain-Barré Syndrome | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Restoring strength, mobility and independence throughout recovery.

overview: Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) is a rapid-onset neurological condition causing progressive weakness and paralysis that can require ventilatory support. Recovery is often lengthy and demands intensive, specialist rehabilitation.

At Cambridge Hospital, our neurorehabilitation team manages GBS patients from the acute recovery phase through ventilator weaning, progressive mobilisation, physiotherapy, occupational therapy and home care - supporting a full return to function wherever possible.
